stem: Which sentence from the article "The Broken-Crayon Solution" best supports the conclusion that Cassidy’s product was profitable?

options.label: A
options.text: She noticed that all of her crayons were broken. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: Cassidy knew that her invention would make many young artists happy. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: Eventually so many crayon holders were sold that Cassidy was able to pay for most of her college education out of her earnings. (paragraph 3)

options.label: D
options.text: Cassidy’s invention encourages others to waste less. (paragraph 4)
